decisionText: Accept T012, ADR 0014 and the parallel integration contract. Authorize starting T013 with the local read-only prototype and agreed limits. M2 remains open. Result promotion and expansion of execution authority are not authorized.

authorized: Implement and measure the bounded local read-only T013 prototype.
Use isolated scratch worktrees and indexes, a private coordinator, declared dependency and resource footprints, and fail-closed verification.
prohibited: Promoting any prototype result or updating the source repository refs.
Executing repository code, tests, hooks, agents, network operations or external effects.
Expanding execution authority or closing M2.
